description: §9.3 thought broadcast, disclosed: every agent's thinking is rendered into the OTHER agents' contexts alongside their speech — never back into the thinker's own — and the prompt says so. Does thinking collapse into performance the moment it has an audience? Trace-rich settings (medium effort, cap 2400) so there are thoughts to broadcast; journal on — under broadcast it is the only private channel left. Tag out of standard §2.5 comparisons.
